blocks.x: [inaudible comments from Terry on Jimmy Rushing, Joe Turner, Joe Williams, Doc Cheatham] [intermittently audible phrases reveal Terry telling stories that Brower asks him to repeat the following week (see below): on the formation of Basie’s small group; on his bringing Ernie Wilkins into Basie’s big band; on his joining Ellington; on Basie’s sense of tempo; on Ellington’s practice of writing for particular individuals, and Ellington’s composition Juniflip on the Flugelhorn, written for Terry; on Ellington prompting Terry to play in the style of Buddy Bolden; on the difficult of a newcomer breaking into Ellington’s band, and Quentin Jackson helping the newcomer Terry identify tunes.] [among largely inaudible comments on Lester Young:] . . . used to love [ ? ? ], particularly the way he made his augmenteds coming out of the bridge [Terry sings]. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Brower and Terry resume, with high quality stereo sound, on June 22, 1999.
